notes.title: A new update is available NOW + Steam Summer Sale!
notes.notes:
A new update is available now for Homestead Arcana!


 Fixed an issue that prevented the player from healing blighted plants
 Fixed the "You Take My Breath Away" achievement (escape miasma without any breath meter) falsely triggering upon respawn when dying in miasma
 Fixed mail bugs that resulted in broken letters
 Fixed asset pop-in while traveling through restored areas
 Changed recipes to ignore stack requirements, allowing the player to buy and pick up recipes in the world that they had already learned from other means, preventing an apparent "inventory full" bug
 Removed the Persevering Token item from the Swamp 
 Fixed Green Ankle Boots being unable to be crafted
 Updated the intro credits sequence
 Allowed the intro video to scale appropriately to screen size


Homestead Arcana is 20% off during the Steam Summer Sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1867520/Homestead_Arcana/

notes.title: Homestead Arcana has a release date and a brand new trailer!
notes.notes:
As you know, in Homestead Arcana you become a farming Witch and pioneer the range that has been mysteriously corrupted with deathly Miasma. 

But what does it all mean? 

Here comes your trusted familiar Huckleberry (voiced by Yuri Lowenthal) to explain: 

[previewyoutube=T66FUUZ7Wu0;full][/previewyoutube]


As you have probably also noticed, we have announced the release date: APRIL 21st! 

Get ready to plant, harvest, craft, cook, and upgrade your gear before you venture out to explore the Miasma and discover its secrets!
